cohort: 360 premenopausal women between the ages of 21 and 50 years, divided into three age groups with 10-year intervals, recruited from Life Care Laboratory and Dhq Hospital in Rawalpindi, Pakistan.
finding: Using ultrasonography, the study found that 63.2% of the women did not have uterine fibroids, while intramural fibroids were common among the others; excessive vaginal bleeding was the most prevalent symptom (47.5%).
